prompts.prompt: What three factors are averaged together to calculate an offense's magnitude score in IBM QRadar? Answer concisely, naming all three.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/qradar/SKILL.md - Offense magnitude formula: Magnitude = (Severity + Relevance + Credibility) / 3

prompts.prompt: According to QRadar deployment sizing guidance, what events-per-second threshold marks the start of an Enterprise-scale deployment? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/qradar/SKILL.md - Typical sizing table: Enterprise deployment is 100,000+ EPS

prompts.prompt: What general SIEM technique does QRadar use to merge identical repeated events within a time window into a single stored event with an incremented count, rather than storing every duplicate? Answer in one word or a short phrase.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/qradar/SKILL.md - Coalescing: identical events within a time window are merged (count incremented)
